svg.title: Takeaway
svg.desc: Return to the ELI16 summary: record the report, preserve the calculation budget and settle each recorded effect with its owner. C1 accepts model-independent processing completion from the trusted relay. C2 owns beliefs and unchanged native math. C3 resolves applied, retired or pending feedback; C4 records later closure without changing historical execution. Native Hive exposes both facts. Both attention providers pass the same closure scenarios; process kills test independent commits. All twelve supported M3.1 gates pass, prior M1–M3 regressions pass, no supported prerequisite is blocked, and chain remains NOT_RUN. Existing pending stores need migration outside scope. This is delivery closure, not new cognition or production readiness.
svg.text: Real Hive + native PLN + replaceable attention
with separate execution and closure progress.
